caption: Same three cloudlets, same 1000 MIPS VM, same 4.8 s makespan. SJF runs the 0.6 s and 1.2 s jobs first, so the average wait drops from 2.2 s to 0.8 s.

spec.aria: Two Gantt lanes for three cloudlets on one 1000 MIPS VM: FCFS runs P1 from 0 to 3 s then P2 and P3, while SJF runs P2 and P3 first so P1 starts at 1.8 s, and both lanes end at 4.8 s.
